macro_simplification: Distinct ordered endpoints make reversed conjunct impossible for one stable u32 value; remaining comparisons are inclusive unsigned comparisons under both explicit int32 contracts.

conversion.32: Same bit pattern only within source-derived range, whose upper bound is below LONG_MAX; no out-of-range u32-to-long32 behavior is modeled
conversion.64: ZeroExt(32,target_read_u32), value-preserving conversion from u32 to signed long64

delivery_path: Only SYS_DVBS or SYS_DSS selected under outer range guard; no enum numeric values invented

division.definedness: denominator != 0 and not (numerator == LONG_MIN and denominator == -1)
division.fault_query: range and assignment/preservation/conversion and target_guard and inner_defined and inner_quotient == 0

execution_model: Only normally executing, live frontend paths reaching the target; other prefix arithmetic faults are not certified
Kernel primitives follow their documented scalar, allocation, buffer-I/O and semaphore semantics; hardware/arbitrary memory corruption not modeled
Five source-pinned in-tree configurations only; callback replacement/out-of-tree is UNKNOWN
evidence_limitations: No original kernel build or TU AST reconstructed
Static source review supplies the field-preservation summary; SMT verifies only scalar implication
No general C parser, pointer/memory/concurrency encoding or R05 integration
